headlines.title: “Missing Forest-for-the-Trees”: Datadog Sinks 17% in a Week as Its Biggest AI Customer Cuts Back
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysDatadog stock fell 17% in a week after a roughly flat fourth-quarter revenue guide outweighed 35% third-quarter growth. The guide counts its largest customer, an AI company that cut its usage, only at its contract minimum.

headlines.title: Datadog (DDOG) Stock Gets Fair Value Trim After Mixed Views On Q4 And AI Demand
headlines.summary: Datadog’s updated fair value estimate has shifted from US$292.36 to US$271.71 per share, which marks a modest reset in how the stock is being valued today. Analysts are split, with some pointing to strong Q3 results, AI related demand and Datadog’s broad customer base, while others lean on softer Q4 guidance, early renewals and volume discounts when considering where the stock should trade.

headlines.title: PuppyGraph Raises $10M Series A to Help Enterprises Build AI Agents That Query 3,000 Tables in Subseconds
headlines.summary: SANTA CLARA, Calif., November 10, 2026--PuppyGraph, the graph query engine for enterprise AI agents, today announced a $10 million Series A led by Particle Future and defy.vc, bringing total funding to $15 million. The round comes after the general availability of PuppyGraph 1.0 and will fund engineering and enterprise go-to-market expansion.

headlines.title: Cloudflare Is Up 11% in a Week. Is Its “Even Higher Gear” Really That Good?
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysCloudflare is up 11% in a week after third-quarter revenue rose 39% to $782. 5 million and its guidance beat estimates.

description: Datadog, Inc. operates an observability and security platform for cloud applications in the United States and internationally. The company's products comprise infrastructure and application performance monitoring, log management, observability pipelines, synthetics, real user monitoring, product analytics, continuous profiler, database monitoring, data observability, LLM observability, error tracking, network monitoring, incident response, workflow automation and App builder, event management, bits AI SRE, cloud cost management, cloud security, code security, cloud SIEM, threat management, sensitive data scanner, and CI visibility. Datadog, Inc. was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in New York, New York.
